item.description: Here's your Woodchuck Weather. Tonight, skies turn mostly cloudy with low temperatures ranging from the mid-forties to the low fifties and only a slight chance of rain. Tomorrow brings mostly cloudy to overcast conditions, highs between sixty and sixty-four, and scattered rain showers possible in some areas, but rainfall amounts will stay light. Tomorrow night, expect partly to mostly cloudy skies with lows in the upper forties to mid-fifties and just a slight chance of lingering showers.
